_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-07-03 · Session 97 · Activities tab decluttered + reports consolidated + MAP naming locked
_status: Cleanup day on your laundry list. The Activities tab is decluttered: one slim bar at the top (Lead + Search + Element Map + Custom Report), and the sidebar is grouped into five sections so the top layer stays calm — everything is still one click away, and the tab is just called 'Activities' now. The Custom Report absorbed the Master Report (one button, a Report Type choice inside), got a real progress bar, titles that match the audience you pick, and your new Elevation slider — sea level writes for a CPL newcomer with every data point; 30,000 ft writes the three-minute board brief. The old-name problem is fixed at the source: every report writer now carries the naming rule (CPL Initiative; Mapping Articulated Pathways platform; the military name is history-only), Sierra got the same rule live, and the public KB's instructions are fixed in a draft PR waiting for your merge. Your team-phrase question got a full plan doc — most gates can switch, four should stay magic-link.

items.text: NEW LOOK: open the Activities tab (sidebar now says just 'Activities', inside the Workplan group). The slim bar sits at the top; 📊 Custom Report now holds BOTH reports — pick ⚡ narrative or 📋 Master, set the audience and the new Elevation slider (sea level = full detail, 30,000 ft = board brief), and watch the progress bar instead of 'Generating…'. Tell Fable if any band's length/detail feels off.

SIDEBAR: the rail is grouped (Workplan / Funding / Strategy & Impact / Reference & Curation / Sierra & Team Tools / Share). Click a header to open or collapse; your layout is remembered per browser. If a grouping feels wrong, say which tab belongs where — it's a one-line change.

MERGE WHEN READY: a draft PR on cpl-knowledge-base fixes the wrong MAP expansion ('Map Academic Pathways') in the assistant instructions and adds the naming conventions (CPL Initiative / Mapping Articulated Pathways platform / old name history-only). Curation-gated — your review is the audit.

RATIFY: docs/team_phrase_expansion_plan.md answers your team-phrase question — widen most remaining magic-link gates in two phases; keep four reviewer-only (TMC CO-approval, phrase management, project hard-delete) and hold the public Fact Sheet. Say 'go Phase 1' and next session executes.

FACT SHEET NAMING: the public fact sheet still says 'MAP Initiative' in its footer/contact/resources boxes. Safest fix is YOU editing those via ✎ Curate (a code edit could orphan existing Curate overrides — the keys derive from the text). Or tell Fable to do the key-migration version.
Sierra day-2 (carryover): the naming rule is now LIVE in the 🧭 guidance pane (deactivate, never delete). Add your own first rule; try the team-session tools; 👎 anything off.

HEADLINE NEXT BUILD (decided, carried over): native team-only attachments — private Supabase Storage bucket + project_attachments table + per-card ⬆ Attach; spec in session_97_handoff.md. SharePoint 📎 stays until it lands.
TOP DATA ASK (mid-July): fresh COCI course extract, ideally WITH contact-hours columns; and can the CO export the 200+ pending ADT submissions as a simple list (college, TMC, date)?

Intro Fable to Malone when ready: the Sierra guardrails lane (durable usage limits, daily cost cap, spam protection) needs his thresholds — the cost cap should land BEFORE the endpoint gets publicized.
